title: Chapter 7187: Lightness Erasure

Chapter 7187: Lightness Erasure

Chapter 7187: Lightness Erasure

“Hahaha.” Heavenfall was ecstatic after the collapse of his halo and said: “Looks like you have received all of his power...”

“Bah.” Li Baye said with disdain: “His power? No, this came from me. Damn it, I couldn’t be lazy and once I tried harder, still stealing my thunder? As if I need any help to have this much power? Just a little bit of cultivation is more than enough.”

Having said that, he waved dismissively: “Forget it, I can’t blame you for being an ignorant country-bumpkin, unable to understand the mysteries of the dao.”

Listeners would vomit blood from hearing this. They struggled to cultivate while Li Baye acted as if cultivation was so easy. Just a bit of effort was all he needed to reach the top. However, they wouldn’t question it due to his achievements.

“Enlighten me with your dao’s power then.” Heavenfall said.

“My dao?” He checked his pocket again before saying: “Wait, this dao is with the mortal world.”

He raised his hand and every inch of land and living beings resonated with him. The primordial lights gathered into massive oceans.

This wasn’t surprising because in the past, when Li Baye spread his dao to create a new system, his light had permeated all worlds.

“What ace card do you have?” Li Baye said while channeling the primordial lights from all worlds.

“My apex power, how about it?” Heavenfall said.

“Go for it.” Li Baye laughed.

“Apex.” Heavenfall closed his eyes before floating upward, becoming as light as a feather: “Lightness Erasure.”

His words were so soft that others questioned if they had heard them correctly.

Lightness Erasure was Heavenfall’s apex power, famous for its destructive capability. As he floated upward, he became lighter and lighter. A speck of dust was heavier than him at this point.

However, once reaching the limit, his weight ventured into the negative. This appeared possible - how could weight ever reach the negative?

This strange phenomenon flipped the world over. Prior to this, Heavenfall’s weight was incalculable but now, the whole world became negative, turning into a part of Heavenfall.

The inversion flipped everything from positive value to the greatest negative value. As the phenomenon reversed and Heavenfall descended toward Li Baye, the negative value flipped to the other direction, somehow doubling the weight of all worlds.

“Rumble!” Spectators watched speechlessly during the descent.

“Chaos.” Li Baye changed the primordial light back to primordial chaos.

The chaos symbolized the unknown. Who knows how many worlds it could birth?

Heavenfall’s weight was double the weight of all worlds. However, Li Baye’s chaos couldn’t be gauged.

“Boom!” Impact caused chaos waves to surge in all directions. Albeit contained, the remnant waves still destroyed minor worlds and their inhabitants.

Nonetheless, this showed Heavenfall’s apex power unable to defeat Li Baye. It appeared Li Baye was now the strongest celestial immortal.

“This is the righteous dao of the world.” An immortal remarked.

His grand dao won over all spectators, even those who didn’t respect him previously.
